key.name: sidebar-on-right
key.description: When true the sidebar is placed on the right edge of the primary monitor. When false it is placed on the left edge.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: Width of the sidebar panel in pixels (48–400).

key.name: button-alignment
key.summary: Vertical alignment of the sidebar buttons
key.description: Where the buttons are aligned inside the sidebar: top, middle or bottom.

key.name: sidebar-color
key.description: CSS color of the sidebar background (hex such as "#1e1e1e", or rgb()/rgba(), or a named color).

key.name: show-action-labels
key.description: Whether to show text labels under the action button icons in the sidebar.

key.name: icon-padding-top
key.description: Padding in pixels above the icon inside each button.

key.name: icon-padding-bottom
key.description: Padding in pixels below the icon/label inside each button.

key.name: icon-padding-left
key.description: Padding in pixels to the left of the icon inside each button.

key.name: icon-padding-right
key.description: Padding in pixels to the right of the icon inside each button.

key.name: actions
key.summary: JSON array of sidebar action definitions
key.description: A JSON-serialised array of action objects. Each object has: type – action type identifier (string) label – button label text (string) icon – symbolic icon name (string) iconColor – CSS colour string, e.g. "#ff0000" (string) enabled – whether the button is shown (boolean) showWhen – "always" (default), "has-window" or "no-window": show the item only when the focused workspace has / has no window open command – shell command for terminal-command / system-command appId – .desktop id for app-shortcut actions shortcut – key combination for keyboard-shortcut actions, e.g. "Ctrl+Shift+T" size – height in pixels for spacer items (type "spacer" and "separator" are layout-only items)
